Tennis court

Fun eateries and shops

Top Shellf by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Top Shellf, a freshly renovated luxury penthouse in Pinnacle Port. This laid-back condo community sits between the Gulf and Lake Powell, Florida’s largest coastal dune lake. It’s the perfect spot to relax and enjoy those amazing Gulf-front views. If and when you get to the sand, you and your sun-chasing favorite get to lounge like royalty on a pair of complimentary beach chairs, with an umbrella, available March through October. Inside, this sleek and inviting open space is consumed by the views! You’ll also appreciate the high-end kitchen, a dining space for 10, and a living area designed for lots of memorable family fun. The sliding doors lead to a spacious balcony with sweeping views from Panama City Beach to Destin. As an end unit, it offers a rare glimpse of Camp Helen State Park and its quiet, expansive beaches—a prime spot to soak in both sunrises and sunsets. The primary bedroom, featuring a king bed, opens up to… you guessed it… more stunning views.

Down the hall, there’s a charming bunk room with 4 twin beds and 2 trundles that kids will adore. The third bedroom is a guest room, king, with its own private bath and, of course, more wonderful views. Top Shellf is an upscale retreat that’s sure to impress. Enjoy! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - Gulf-front penthouse - Complimentary seasonal beach chair service, 2 chairs and umbrella (March-October) - 3 bedroom, 3 bath - Tennis court - Basketball court - Shallow private inlet - 1,263 sq ft - Wi-Fi - Cable in living room (streaming in bedrooms) - Boat ramp and boat slips at no charge to use (Trailer parking fee is $10/spot for each week you are here and is payable to the Pinnacle Port business office) Overnight: - King in primary bedroom; private bath; TV - Bunk room with 4 twin beds and 2 twin trundles; private bath; - King in guest bedroom; private bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
